supplementary_explanation: Option 1 - Agnes: You need a paid Agnes plan and working subscription API access. It makes the pictures and 720p motion clips using your remaining plan quota. The clips are 10 seconds each; this skill supports selected lengths up to 5 minutes on Agnes.
The daily planning limits here are 500 video seconds and 4,000 images, shared across keys of the same type. Remaining quota and provider limits still apply; the whole video must fit that day.

Option 2 - KIE.ai: Use KIE.ai's video models, including premium options. You'll choose the model next, see the estimated cost, and approve it before generation. KIE.ai also supplies the pictures; image and video usage is billed against your KIE.ai credits.

With either choice, the Suno song and Kling talking close-ups still use KIE.ai and are billed separately. Those charges are included in the estimate and must stay within your approved spending limit. Choosing Agnes does not make the whole production free.
Neither option is selected for you; choose 1 or 2.
